events.statement: order-service latency_p99_ms was flat ~150ms through 08:32 bucket, then jumped to avg 3113ms / max 5629ms in the 08:51 bucket and settled ~5200-5367ms from 09:10 onward.
order-service error_rate (HTTP 5xx) jumped to 8.94% at exactly 09:00:00Z from a ~0.2% baseline (per-minute data shows 0.22% at 08:59 and 8.94% at 09:00).
order-service logs show 70 ERROR entries, all of pattern 'ledger-db: canceling statement due to statement timeout (INSERT INTO orders)', first seen 09:00:42Z.

ledger-db logs show 94 WARN slow-query entries, all 'SELECT * FROM trades WHERE account_id=$1 AND executed_at > $2 ORDER BY executed_at -- Seq Scan on trades (rows=48211907) application_name=portfolio-service', first seen 08:58:38Z.
ledger-db CPU jumped from ~30% baseline to avg 71.57%/max 97.58% in the 08:51 bucket and stayed ~96% from 09:10 onward.
ledger-db slow_queries_per_min jumped from ~1/min baseline to avg 89.51/max 148.81 in the 08:51 bucket and ~140/min thereafter.
ledger-db connections_active rose from ~62 baseline to avg 142/max 199 in the 08:51 bucket and ~190 thereafter.
order-service db_pool_in_use rose from ~14 baseline to avg 33/max 51 in the 08:51 bucket, settling ~45, consistent with connections blocked on the slow DB.
Deployment dep-5905 (portfolio-service v4.5.0, deployed 08:56:00Z) added a 'new query on trades filtered by account_id + executed_at' with 'no migration included' and is live (not rolled back).
portfolio-service logs confirm deployment dep-5905 rollout complete at 08:56:32Z, immediately followed by 239 WARN 'holdings P&L query took <n>ms' messages first seen 08:59:39Z.

The only config change was cfg-2903 on ledger-db at 08:00:00Z (autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor 0.2 -> 0.1); ledger-db logs confirm it applied at 08:00:20Z and autovacuum processed only public.audit_log.
Request rates were flat across the onset for both order-service (~230 req/s) and portfolio-service (~570 req/s), i.e. no traffic surge.
ledger-db logs contain NO WARN/ERROR entries in the window 07:00-08:58Z (total_matched 0), so the slow-query pattern began only at 08:58:38Z.
Historical incident HIST-111 (2025-05-22) had the same class: 'New report query without index did sequential scans' slowing ledger-db, category bad_deployment.
portfolio-service p99 latency jumped from ~178ms baseline to avg 4490ms in the 08:51 bucket and ~6900ms thereafter.
portfolio-service depends on ledger-db (db) and order-service also depends on ledger-db (db); ledger-db is a shared postgres datastore.
